method: Deterministic 5000-draw bootstrap resampling official GAME DATES with replacement; paired game-level differences; 95% percentile intervals.
interpretation: Negative delta favors the MLB Forecast Lab model. Intervals crossing zero do not show a reliable difference. This remains a RETROSPECTIVE sample with prior model-development exposure.
limitations: Small 2026 playoffs sample with clustered game dates; original model not independently untouched and archived pregame starter IDs unavailable.
